name: Zombie Villager
prompt: A low-poly 3D model reference sheet of a male zombie, in the style of Nintendo 64 Zelda: Ocarina of Time. He stands in a strict T-pose, front view, centered, full body visible. His skin is a sickly pale green with visible tears and exposed bone on his forearms and shins. He wears tattered, dark brown trousers and a ripped, light blue tunic. His eyes are sunken and black. The overall aesthetic features simple, bold shapes and flat colours. Pure-white background, no shadows, no text.
